text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, it was just last fall...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
When the unbeatable condor was
brought down
at Tokyo Racecourse...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
By none other than the strongest
Umamusume in
all the country—the
Non-stop Runaway, Silence
Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But these broken wings have been
healed by the
love of my friends, my
teachers, and my
unwavering spirit!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
My comeback will happen right here, at
the
Takarazuka Kinen! And after that, I'll
take my
rightful place at the throne!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Suuuzukaaa! Let's have a good race
today!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I can do! I've done

everything I can't do! I've done it all to
prepare
for this day!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Even at the Fan Fest, you were
something else... I
don't think there's a
single area where I'm better
than you...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But I'm still gonna take you down! If I
don't win,
there's no way I'll make it on
an international
level!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Here in front of this massive audience, I
swear on
the sky I'll win today!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса's challenge sends the
crowd into a
frenzy even greater than at
the Mainichi Okan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'll see you out there! Chao!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You're wrong, El...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I'm not as great as you think I am...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You have a strength unfamiliar to me. A
strength I
don't have.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
When you hear the voices around you...
you
change.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You kept getting back up at the Fan
Fest.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Every cheer gave you new strength.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And it wasn't just your fans either. Your
friends
have made you stronger as well.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
If you brought that strength with you
today...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You may be the only one who can
intrude upon
my scenery.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But I won't let you get in the way of my
perfect
view.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
